description: Decision tree for inferring events from UI signals. 13 generic patterns — platform-agnostic. Canonical event names come from the GTM snapshot at runtime.

naming_conventions.click_zone: click_%zone where zone = functional block name on the page (accommodation, activities, header, search…)
naming_conventions.display_content: display_%content_type where content_type = the component type (highlight, newsletter, top_banner…)
naming_conventions.detail_click_slug: snake_case, language-independent stable id — not a localised label

double_push_pattern.description: All click_* events MUST be pushed twice in sequence: first with event_click: null to reset the previous value, then with event_click populated.

patterns.name: page_load
patterns.summary: Initial page load or SPA virtual page (new URL or route change)
patterns.when: Every page rendered — real navigation AND error pages
patterns.notes: search_results fires alongside page_view on search-result pages. For SPA layers that do NOT change the URL, use P02 instead.

patterns.name: layer_open
patterns.summary: Full-screen SPA layer or side panel opens without URL navigation
patterns.when: A click triggers a full-screen overlay or panel in a SPA (no browser navigation)
patterns.notes: Two events in sequence: (1) click_%zone (P07) is the trigger, then (2) this page_view with page_name ending in _layer. page_name = {section}_{step}_layer, e.g. be_accommodation_layer.

patterns.name: search_interaction
patterns.summary: User interacts with a search or filter widget (dates, destination, participants, criteria)
patterns.when: Any field of the search widget is opened, filled, or validated
patterns.notes: click_search = global search widget. click_price_remote = search widget embedded inside a product/detail page.

patterns.name: global_nav
patterns.summary: Click on persistent navigation UI: header, footer, contact bar, info banner
patterns.when: User clicks a header CTA, footer link, contact element, or a persistent info banner
patterns.notes: click_header: account, auth, save CTAs. click_footer / click_contact: contact, FAQ, legal, WhatsApp. click_infobanner: persistent top banners. detail_click = specific action.

patterns.name: funnel_progress
patterns.summary: User advances or retreats in a multi-step form or checkout flow
patterns.when: Continue / Back / Skip CTA in a multi-step funnel
patterns.notes: Named click_bottom_bar on Club Med BE. On other apps, name the zone after its UI element — the pattern is what matters.

patterns.name: criteria_edit
patterns.summary: User edits journey or search criteria from within a funnel step without leaving it
patterns.when: Breadcrumb or inline shortcut for editing dates, transport, participants while inside the funnel
patterns.notes: Named click_breadcrumb on Club Med. On other apps, use click_%zone where zone is the modification widget name.

patterns.name: content_click
patterns.summary: Click on any product or content element in a named functional zone
patterns.when: Any user click that is NOT header/footer/search widget/funnel nav — the default for all content interactions
patterns.notes: zone = functional block name (accommodation, activities, transport, highlights, resort, dashboard…). detail_click = specific action. This is the most common pattern — default to it for any content click.

patterns.name: media_view
patterns.summary: User opens a media gallery, floor plan, 360° view, or video
patterns.when: Photo gallery, room plan, immersive view, or video is opened
patterns.notes: Sub-pattern of P07. detail_click = media_%type. zone = the page section containing the media trigger.

patterns.name: option_toggle
patterns.summary: User adds or removes an optional item (upsell, add-on, insurance, upgrade)
patterns.when: Add/remove a paid option, insurance, upgrade, or any optional product component
patterns.notes: click_upsell for standalone upsell blocks. Use click_%zone (P07) when add/remove is inside a zone (e.g., room personalization inside click_accommodation).

patterns.name: filter_sort
patterns.summary: User applies, removes, or resets a filter or sort on a catalog or layer
patterns.when: Filter chip selected, sort changed, filter panel opened or reset
patterns.notes: zone = the catalog or layer being filtered. On full-page catalogs without a _layer suffix, use click_%zone instead.

patterns.name: error
patterns.summary: User-visible error: form validation failure, action error, or error page render
patterns.when: Form submitted with validation errors, an action fails, or a 4xx/5xx page renders
patterns.notes: form_error = form validation failure (no extra params). click_error = action error (detail_click = error_%type). Error pages use page_view (P01) with page_name = error_%type.

patterns.name: ecommerce
patterns.summary: GA4 standard ecommerce: product view, funnel entry, wishlist, purchase, conversion
patterns.when: User views a product, enters checkout, saves to wishlist, purchases, or triggers a transactional conversion
patterns.notes: Standard GA4 ecommerce schema. items[] required for purchase / add_to_cart / view_item. option_held and upsell_transaction are conversion milestones within the funnel.

patterns.name: content_display
patterns.summary: Content becomes visible to the user without an explicit click (impression event)
patterns.when: A banner, modal, notification, or recommendation renders in the viewport
patterns.notes: content_type = component type (highlight, newsletter, floating_banner, top_banner, toaster, popin…). Fire when the component enters the viewport or is rendered visible.
